name: M31V J00443799+4129236 A
description: The primary star of M31V J00443799+4129236, an eclipsing pair of hot stars in the Andromeda Galaxy, 23.1 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; the two eclipse each other every 3.549694 days.

radius.source: Primary radius 13.1 +/- 0.3 solar radii, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

mass.source: Primary mass 23.1 +/- 1.3 solar masses, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

temperature.source: Primary Teff 33900 +/- 500 K, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

gravity.source: Primary log g 3.57 +/- 0.03 (cgs), Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

radialVelocity.source: Systemic velocity gamma -173 +/- 4 km/s of the pair, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2

distance.source: Distance 772 +/- 44 kpc, (m-M)0 = 24.44 +/- 0.12 mag, from the pair's own radii, temperatures and brightness, Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Sect. 4

text.card: The primary star of an eclipsing pair in the Andromeda Galaxy, one orbit every 3.549694 days.
text.introduction: It has 23.1 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; its partner has 15.0 and 11.3. The pair gave a direct distance to the galaxy: 772 kiloparsecs.
text.locator: Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37, Table 2: M, R, P and the distance

notes: Masses, radii, temperatures, the orbit and the distance are all from Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37.
